expected_source: value produced by building the identical C source with an independent host C compiler (cc -std=gnu99, identical at -O0 and -O2; the arithmetic is unsigned throughout and 32-bit unsigned int matches the C6000 EABI, so the fold is defined), with the host branch of the __TI_COMPILER_VERSION__ split putting the same working set in a static array instead of DDR2; the emulator was not involved. The two optimisation levels are the two access orderings the compiler produces for volatile loops - straight-line at -O2 and software-pipelined at -O3 - because what this program varies is the cache configuration rather than the code generation, and the answer is the same at every level.
